result: A general online-to-nonconvex conversion contains schedule-free SGD as a special case, so SF-SGD reaches (λ, ε)-stationary points of nonsmooth nonconvex losses with the optimal O(λ^(1/2)ε^(−7/2)) gradients, hence O(ε⁻⁴) for smooth and O(ε^(−3.5)) for second-order smooth losses. The analysis also explains the practical choices β ≈ 1 and large base steps.
result_plain: Schedule-free SGD is optimal for nonsmooth nonconvex stationarity: O(ε⁻⁴) smooth, O(ε^(−3.5)) second-order smooth.
